title: Case #4 — Redshifted radio galaxies · Arp 299, 6.5 GHz (Band 5a), native z = 0.0109
description: SKA-Mid AA* observation of the native Arp 299 continuum model (z = 0.0109) in Band 5a: 6.55 GHz centre, 3900 MHz in 64 channels, 600 s around transit. WSClean multiscale imaging at Briggs robust -2, 2048 x 2048 pixels over 72 arcsec, 10000 iterations with mgain 0.5. One of 18 Arp 299 runs (native redshift and z = 0.15–2.00, in Bands 2, 5a and 5b) behind the redshift sequence.
